items.title: Yocto 5.0 Scarthgap LTS maintenance release 5.0.4
items.summary: Updated BitBake recipes and hardening patches for reproducible embedded builds.
items.content: The Yocto Project announces release 5.0.4 of Scarthgap LTS. Includes updated security advisories, reproducible build manifest validation, and WIC image layout fixes for read-only root filesystems.

items.title: Optimizing QEMU x86_64 kernel boot times under 1 second
items.summary: Stripping unneeded driver modules and enabling initcall debugging for rapid boot.
items.content: Case study on configuring minimal kernel fragments, disabling serial console bloat, and optimizing initramfs for instant containerized and virtual machine initialization.
